concepts.proposed_markdown: The deprecated Plans `POST /v1/credits/listEntries` operation returns credit-type ledgers grouped by customer. Optional payload filters select customer IDs, credit-type IDs, an inclusive `starting_on`, and an exclusive non-future `ending_before`; when the upper bound is omitted, the window runs through the start of each customer's next billing period. Query `sort` orders ledgers by date and defaults to ascending, while nullable `next_page` paginates the required customer-ledger array. Each ledger separates posted from pending entries and starting and ending balances that expose `excluding_pending`, `including_pending`, and an effective timestamp. Entries associated with voided credit grants are omitted, so this surface is not a complete grant history. Its entry schema does not expose a Contracts-style ledger-entry type, and the page defines no page size, cursor lifecycle, snapshot consistency, freshness, or Plan-to-Contract replacement mapping. [[source-metronome-api-reference-credit-grants-list-credit-ledger-entries]]
warnings: Preserve the voided-grant visibility exclusion; do not describe this endpoint as a complete historical ledger.
Keep this deprecated Plans schema separate from current Contracts balance and ledger schemas.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-metronome-api-reference-credit-grants-list-credit-ledger-entries]] - deprecated Plans credit-ledger listing, customer and credit-type filters, time windows, pagination, pending-balance separation, and voided-grant visibility boundary

The deprecated Plans `POST /v1/credits/listEntries` endpoint lists credit ledgers across customers and directs new clients to Contracts. The page does not name an equivalent Contracts route, map Plan credit-grant or ledger identity to Contract credits or commits, provide migration steps, or state a removal date. Its exclusion of entries associated with voided grants is a Plans-surface visibility rule and does not establish current Contracts archival or ledger-retention behavior. [[source-metronome-api-reference-credit-grants-list-credit-ledger-entries]]
warnings: Do not invent a Contracts replacement route or identity mapping from the deprecation notice.
Do not generalize the legacy voided-grant exclusion into a current Contracts retention rule.
